obligations.title: Maintain physical, technical and organizational safeguards protecting Arcadia's systems and data.
Cooperate and provide information to support investigation and remediation of Security Incidents.
Deliver a written root-cause analysis and implement corrective measures after a monthly availability failure.
Provide timely access, information and approvals needed for the Services.
Escalate disputes to senior executives for good-faith resolution before court proceedings.
Enter a written data protection agreement before any Services involving personal data begin.
obligations.clause_heading: DATA PROTECTION AND SECURITY (11.2 Change in Scope)

obligations.title: Cooperate in orderly transition and return Arcadia's equipment and data on expiry or termination.
